scripts.dev: python3 scripts/sync_env.py && bash scripts/valkey.sh start && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,beat,web "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:beat" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:py: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run lint-imports
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:py && npm run test:unit:web
scripts.test:integration:py: bash team/bin/app.sh supabase && bash scripts/valkey.sh start && uv run --directory backend pytest tests/integration -q
scripts.test:integration: bash team/bin/app.sh start && npm run test:integration:py && npm run test:db && npm run test:integration:web && npm run check:db-types && npm run check:openapi
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --directory backend celery -A autoapplier.worker.celery_app worker --loglevel INFO --concurrency 2 --queues default
scripts.dev:beat: uv run --directory backend celery -A autoapplier.worker.celery_app beat --loglevel INFO --schedule .celerybeat-schedule
scripts.gen:openapi: uv run --directory backend python -m autoapplier.api.export_openapi --out openapi.json
scripts.gen:api-types: npm run gen:openapi && npm run gen:api-types -w @autoapplier/web
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:py
